extensionsMoved.title: Views of cluster tools are now extensions
extensionsMoved.text: Flux, Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, Argo Workflows, Velero, Knative, Kyverno, CloudNativePG, Strimzi, External Secrets, Sealed Secrets, Prometheus Operator, Vertical Pod Autoscaler, Dynamic Resource Allocation, NVIDIA GPU Operator, Kueue, JobSet, KubeRay, KServe and Operator Lifecycle Manager moved out of Sextant into its own extensions from the extension catalog, which are updated on their own. Install the ones you use below: until then their sections are not shown. Your notification settings for them were kept, and the sidebar also offers them in clusters that run these tools.

api4.title: Extension API 4
api4.text: Extensions can now have sidebar sections with Sextant's own tables, computed columns, one-click actions, services inside the cluster and tools for AI agents: enough to build these four views on the public API.

agentTools.title: GitOps tools for AI agents are now the extensions'
agentTools.text: The MCP tool gitops_action is gone: the Flux and Argo CD extensions give agents Reconcile, Suspend and Resume, and Sync, Refresh and Hard refresh. To let agents use them, turn on the extension's tools in Settings → AI agents (MCP).

extensions.title: Install the extensions that moved
extensions.hint: Each package is checked and asks for your consent before it is installed.
extensions.catalogOff: The extension catalog is turned off: turn it on in Settings → Extensions to install them.

about.flux: Sources, Kustomizations, HelmReleases, image automation and notifications
about.argo-cd: Applications with sync, health, resources, history and diff
about.argo-rollouts: Rollouts with steps, weights and analysis; promote, abort and pause
about.argo-workflows: Workflows with their step tree and logs, CronWorkflows and templates
about.strimzi: Kafka clusters, topics, users, connectors and mirrors
about.olm: Subscriptions, operators, install plans and catalogs
about.jobset: JobSets with their Jobs, restarts and failures
about.kuberay: Ray clusters, jobs and services with their logs
about.kserve: InferenceServices, serving runtimes and inference graphs
about.knative: Serving Services, revisions and routes; Eventing brokers, triggers, channels and sources
about.gpu-operator: ClusterPolicies, NVIDIA drivers, their components and GPU nodes
about.dra: ResourceClaims with their devices, claim templates, device classes, ResourceSlices and the Devices page
about.velero: Backups, schedules, restores and storage locations; back up a namespace or restore a backup
about.kueue: ClusterQueues with quota and usage, LocalQueues, Workloads and why they wait
about.kyverno: Policies with their mode and results, policy reports and every object's results
about.sealed-secrets: SealedSecrets with their sync state, scope, target Secret and sealed keys, and the controller with its sealing keys
about.vpa: VerticalPodAutoscalers with their state and recommendation and what a new pod would get, their checkpoints and components, and every workload's VPAs
about.prometheus-operator: ServiceMonitors, PodMonitors and Probes with what they select, PrometheusRules, Prometheuses and Alertmanagers
